event_chain.summary: Privilege abuse - warrant data shared via Snapchat

summary: A deputy clerk at the Putnam County (Florida) Clerk of Courts, employed for about a year, accessed the criminal court information system, sometimes from home, and shared confidential arrest-warrant information with known drug traffickers via Snapchat screenshots. Sheriff's investigators found the leak in June 2026 after suspects were tipped off before a planned operation; 60 to 80 criminal investigations may have been compromised. She was fired, arrested on June 10, 2026 and charged with 17 felonies.
